electional_timing_system.purpose: Choosing auspicious timing for activities based on planetary rulership of hours
electional_timing_system.historical_basis: Ancient Babylonian and Hellenistic timing techniques using Chaldean planetary order

fundamental_principles.time_division: Each day (sunrise to sunset) and night (sunset to sunrise) divided into 12 equal planetary hours
fundamental_principles.planetary_sequence: Chaldean order from slowest to fastest visible planet: Saturn → Jupiter → Mars → Sun → Venus → Mercury → Moon
fundamental_principles.variable_length: Hour length changes with seasons and latitude (longer day hours in summer, longer night hours in winter)
fundamental_principles.day_rulership: First hour after sunrise determines planetary day ruler, which sets sequence for remaining hours
